pr_title: Feature: Add a UI to edit, delete and create tags
pr_body:
**Resolved / Related Issues**
Items resolved / related issues by this PR.
- Closes #9588

**Supported Features**
- Add a new tag (name = "New Tag" and random color)
- Rename an existing tag
- Delete an existing tag
- Change color of an existing tag (Color Picker as for app bg)
- Sidebar section, Tags Widget and right click context menu are all synced

**Notes**
- `CommandBar.MinWidth=250` is needed to avoid a UI bug involving localization
- `ColorHelpers.FromHex()` now works even when alpha is specified
- I created a method to remove a `GoTo` in `AdvancedViewModel`
- `FileTagsSettingsService.GetTagAndIndex()` is basically an `IndexOf` which does not work (always returns -1)
- I'm not sure why (I'll check this out), but to edit `FileTagList` you need to reassign it

**Validation**
How did you test these changes?
- [x] Built and ran the app
- [ ] Tested the changes for accessibility

**Screenshots (optional)**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39923744/218348585-7f542d16-d4ce-41fa-ac20-dbcb577c946e.png)

issue_context.title: Feature: Add a UI to edit, delete and create tags
issue_context.body:
This issue is open for discussion.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39923744/179832337-66b4601f-bde1-456d-900e-aa5d9a454c14.png)

- Should the UI for creating tag have its own dialog or should it be part of settings?
- Should you be able to right click the tags section on the sidebar to create a new tag or should you have to open the manage tags UI and do it from there?

**Requirements**
- Add a list under experimental settings for adding/deleting tags
- There should be a way to edit existing tags as well
comments: Adding a new tag option in the tag management page and the context menu would proberly be best. Some properly would expect it to work like a library and other would in the dialog/settings.
I think it doesn't matter. As long as this feature comes. In the current version, the labels cannot be customized. Is this a special problem for me or I don't understand if this feature is closed?

I think the right-click option is the best. We already have a lot of settings and I don't think we should keep overcrowding them.
Maybe we can add two different user interfaces:
- New tag 
  - A simple, small modal that allows you to quickly create a tag (choose color and name);
- Manage tags
  - A settings-like modal where you can create, edit, and remove tags. Renaming tags could work as inline renaming. I'm not sure, but I'd like a count of tagged files (e.g. `Red: 30 tags`).
I think it'll have to be part of settings because users can already hide the sidebar section.

> I think it'll have to be part of settings because users can already hide the sidebar section.

I was thinking of the righ click option because of this: if the user hides `Tag Section` it won't probably use tags so she/he doesn't need that setting

Based on the open pull request shouldn't there be a new page in settings for tags rather then having the context menu option in Appearance and the editing/creating in Advanced. I think it would make it less hidden and crowded.

I temporarily created it in Advanced to follow requirements, but I think a new page would make sense

> Add a list under experimental settings for adding/deleting tags
We will move them to a new page in the near future, I want some time to test the changes before officially making tags a supported feature.

review_comments: Same thing here, why are we replacing the list?
Can we add directly to FileTagsList?

> I think RemoveAt only modifies the current object, but does not set the property (does this make sense?). This results in the Set method, which stores the values in the JSON file, not being called.

`Get` reads from JSON and `Set` saves to JSON
Worth moving into its own file to not clutter the class.

I would have suggested still in `ViewModels`, but in an entire new class. But after looking at the code from within the Visual Studio, I see the class is only used insside the `AvancedViewModel`, so if we're sure it will never be used elsewhere, it may stay there.
May I ask what is the use of the `Backed` namespace?
I forgot an `N` it should have been `BackeNd.ViewModels.FileTags`, which is where other Tags view models are
In that case, that might be a good idea!
What's this for? Is it still needed with the button to commit the rename?
I can remove `Esc` and `Enter`. Still, I think we should handle `arrows`. If we don't, when the user is at the beginning/end of the textbox and he presses up/down, other items will be selected
I'd prefer it if we stuck with the edit and confirm button for this. We can keep enter though.

> I'd prefer it if we stuck with the edit and confirm button for this.

That is what I meant, we have to handle `Up/Down` arrows to avoid selecting other items.

> We can keep enter though.

I'll reintroduce that
